completion_scope: broader ambitions and per-target failure limits
review_policy: independent internal reviews, not external peer review

records.title: Unique optimum does not make forced-1-tree elimination sparse
records.statement: For every k>=17 a strict integer metric on 10k cities has a unique optimal tour, while every forced rooted 1-tree bound, at any root and real potentials, is below OPT.
records.remaining: This concerns this relaxation family only; stronger cuts and other elimination rules remain possible.

records.title: Exact graphical TSP on the sparse generating graph
records.statement: Metric TSP on all generating vertices equals a minimum connected spanning positive-even multigraph with multiplicities 0/1/2. Frontier parity-and-partition DP is exact.
records.remaining: Width is that of the generating graph/order, not of the complete metric; no universal fast runtime.

records.title: Exponential endpoint-state quotient on certified residuals
records.statement: Dropping component labels on saturated boundary vertices preserves all suffix behavior. An explicit certified residual family collapses 2^(n-6) realizable full-partition states to one.
records.remaining: Existential representation reduction, not a total-runtime factor or universal superiority. The family is dense; existing controls can remain slower than subset DP.

records.title: Path/star guarantees and polynomial tree-metric descent
records.statement: NN on positive weighted paths is at most 3/2 OPT; stars are optimal. Every tree-metric 2-opt local optimum is optimal and any strict descent takes at most (n-1)(floor(n/2)-1) moves.
records.remaining: Q3817 remains unresolved and stops after five reviewed NN-ratio routes. The full sparse expected-descent result is filed separately.

records.title: Polynomial expected 2-opt descent in the full sparse exponential model
records.statement: For every connected simple generating graph with m independent Exp(1) weights, any initializer and strictly improving pivot have E[moves] <= 10m(m-1)n^5(1+log(n!)). For m<=cn this is O_c(n^8 log n).
records.remaining: Polynomial convergence was already established in TCS 2021 Theorem 20. The normalized local proof gives a cut-free bound; originality is not established. This counts real-arithmetic moves/scans and does not resolve NN quality or exact TSP.

records.title: Five learned policies without a supported advantage
records.statement: Controlled held-family and held-size comparisons retain 320 independently checked original-cost packets. Five distinct learned objectives/estimators establish no practically meaningful advantage over ordinary/random/manual allocation after charging training and inference.
records.remaining: A bounded negative experiment, not a proof that useful learning is impossible. Time-budget overruns and iterative use of the test suite are disclosed.

records.title: Exact fractional gaps and scoped path rounding
records.statement: One-spoke Petersen subdivisions on n=l+9 cities have a half-integral extreme subtour-LP point with LP=n and metric OPT=n+1 for every l>=1; an explicit path attains the optimum.
records.remaining: This restricted gap tends to one. It does not prove the unrestricted 4/3 conjecture; P4 stops at five reviewed broader failed routes.

records.title: Per-problem failed-route register
records.statement: The seven unresolved catalog questions and P1/P4/P6 each reach their own five reviewed failed routes. Q3818/P5 are locally solved; P2 attains its existential state-reduction ambition and P3 its full sparse expected-descent ambition.
records.remaining: Stopping a research run does not settle an unresolved mathematical question. The same subagent was retained; no public publication is part of this filing.
